summary: Give the app a way to find, start and report on the Godot world viewer

coordination.notes: The chain currently ends in nothing: godot/ builds an exe via tools/export-godot-viewer.mjs, and no code anywhere launches it, it is not in tauri.conf.json resources, and no UI can open it. Every piece built for the viewer is therefore unreachable by a player. Dan gave ownership of the whole game on 4 Sep 2026, so this takes the launch/lifecycle side that section 2 of the handoff doc had listed under Codex. Follows lich.rs's established external-process pattern (three-state running/running_known, refuse a second instance only when known, non-fatal throughout) rather than inventing a second one. Deliberately NOT adding the exe to tauri.conf.json resources in this slice: the file does not exist unless someone runs the export, and a missing resource fails the whole bundle build. Godot reads the bridge port and token off disk itself, so nothing is passed on the command line - same reasoning as lich.rs refusing to put a password there.
